bio: Catherine Adcock is the Program Coordinator at the Harvard Data Science Initiative. She provides administrative support to the HDSI, Harvard Data Science Review, and to Dr. Francesca Dominici in her roles of faculty co-director of the HDSI and Professor of Biostatistics. Catherine graduated from Capital University with a BA in History....
